purpose: Audit-only exact-identity crosswalk; never promotes source-image review choices into production

identityPolicy.positiveMatch: Exact canonical museum object ID, exact Commons File identity, exact recorded canonical legacy Commons filename ID, or separately verified museum accession linking an alternate Commons photo
identityPolicy.notAMatch: Matching artist and/or title is insufficient; even different museum accession IDs may be separate works
identityPolicy.noConfirmedIdentity: Candidate is unlinked, not proven to be a new physical artwork
identityPolicy.photoPolicy: All accepted choices require independent exact-image licensing and native-image QA
identityPolicy.historicLocks: Existing canonical editorial state must not be overwritten; raw user photo approval remains tied to original source ID
identityPolicy.extraWithinNewBatch: Same-work/multi-source and ensemble relationships remain separate from canonical match
identityPolicy.rightsHold: All four B13 source remediation cases retain holds; notably commons:85666930 is photographer CC BY-SA 4.0
